findings.name: Emoji as interface icons
findings.why: Emoji standing in for iconography in features, nav, or footers.

findings.name: No visible keyboard focus
findings.why: Interactive elements with no :focus-visible style: the polish gap, and an accessibility defect.

findings.name: Motion without prefers-reduced-motion
findings.why: Animation that ignores reduced-motion settings fails users who asked for less movement.

findings.name: A face from the 'tasteful free font' cluster
findings.why: Space Grotesk, Geist, Syne, Sora, Instrument Serif, Fraunces, Cal Sans: the non-generic choices that became generic.

findings.name: Template chrome: meta strings joined with middle dots
findings.why: 'A · B · C' metadata strings are a stock chrome move, not a decision about this content.

findings.name: Template chrome: 'WORD — fragment' labels
findings.why: Labels built as an uppercase word + spaced em dash + fragment are a recurring generated pattern.

findings.name: Inter as the primary face
findings.why: Inter is the default of nearly every AI tool and component library.

findings.name: One radius + soft shadow on every surface
findings.why: Identical radius and shadow everywhere flattens hierarchy into a template.

findings.name: Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur)
findings.why: Frosted surfaces by reflex; keep blur only where layering is real, like a nav over scrolling content.

findings.name: Template chrome: tracked ALL-CAPS labels
findings.why: An uppercase, letter-spaced label on everything is chrome that appears whatever the subject.

findings.name: Every card lifts on hover
findings.why: A rise-and-shadow on every card, clickable or not, is motion with no meaning; Anthropic lists 'hover transitions on every card'.
